events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Remembering John Lennon, who was born on October 9, 1940, and would have been 86 today.

angles.name: Lennon's Legacy
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we're reflecting on the enduring genius of John Lennon. What's your favourite post-Beatles track?

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Happy 87th birthday to the legendary English actor, comedian, and writer, John Cleese, born on October 27, 1939.

angles.name: Comedy Icon
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the one and only John Cleese! From Python to Fawlty Towers, his comedic brilliance is timeless.

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' released in 1968
events.blurb: On this day in 1968, The Beatles released their ninth studio album, 'The Beatles', commonly known as the 'White Album'.

angles.name: White Album Legacy
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years ago today, The Beatles unleashed the iconic 'White Album'. A double album of pure genius and experimentation – what's your standout track?

events.title: Anniversary of Freddie Mercury's death
events.blurb: Today marks 35 years since the passing of Queen frontman Freddie Mercury on November 24, 1991.

angles.name: Tribute to Freddie
angles.copy: Thirty-five years ago today, we lost an icon. Remembering the unparalleled talent and showmanship of Freddie Mercury. His legend lives on.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' released in 1965
events.blurb: On this day in 1965, The Beatles released their sixth studio album, 'Rubber Soul'.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Legacy
angles.copy: Sixty-one years ago, The Beatles gave us 'Rubber Soul'. A pivotal album that saw them push new musical boundaries. What's your favourite track?

events.title: Anniversary of John Lennon's death
events.blurb: Today marks 46 years since the tragic death of John Lennon on December 8, 1980.

angles.name: Remembering John Lennon
angles.copy: Forty-six years ago today, the music world fell silent. Remembering John Lennon, whose peace-loving spirit and timeless songs continue to inspire.

events.title: David Bowie would have been 80
events.blurb: Remembering the visionary David Bowie, who was born on January 8, 1947, and would have been 80 today.

angles.name: Bowie's Starman Legacy
angles.copy: On what would have been his 80th birthday, we're celebrating the extraordinary life and music of David Bowie. A true innovator, forever missed.

events.title: Elvis Presley would have been 92
events.blurb: Remembering the King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, who was born on January 8, 1935, and would have been 92 today.

angles.name: The King's Enduring Reign
angles.copy: On what would have been his 92nd birthday, we're celebrating the one and only Elvis Presley. The King's influence on music is simply unmatched.

events.title: Jimmy Page turns 83
events.blurb: Wishing a very happy 83rd birthday to the legendary Led Zeppelin guitarist, Jimmy Page, born on January 9, 1944.

angles.name: Guitar God's Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 83rd birthday to the maestro, Jimmy Page! His riffs shaped a generation and continue to inspire. What's your favourite Led Zeppelin track?

events.title: Rod Stewart turns 82
events.blurb: Wishing a very happy 82nd birthday to the iconic British singer, Sir Rod Stewart, born on January 10, 1945.

angles.name: Rod the Mod's Day
angles.copy: Happy 82nd birthday to the incomparable Rod Stewart! His distinctive voice and incredible career continue to entertain. What's your favourite Rod hit?

events.title: Suggs turns 66
events.blurb: Wishing a very happy 66th birthday to Suggs, the iconic frontman of Madness, born Graham McPherson on January 13, 1961.

angles.name: Madness Frontman
angles.copy: Happy 66th birthday to the legendary Suggs from Madness! Forever bringing the house down with his unique brand of British ska.

events.title: Paul Young turns 71
events.blurb: Wishing a very happy 71st birthday to the blue-eyed soul singer Paul Young, born on January 17, 1956.

angles.name: 80s Soul Icon
angles.copy: Happy 71st birthday to Paul Young! That voice defined the 80s for so many. What's your favourite hit from him?

events.title: Dolly Parton turns 81
events.blurb: Wishing a very happy 81st birthday to the legendary country and pop icon, Dolly Parton, born on January 19, 1946.

angles.name: Queen of Country Turns 81
angles.copy: Happy 81st birthday to the one and only Dolly Parton! A true legend whose talent and generosity shine as brightly as her rhinestones.

events.title: Gary Barlow turns 56
events.blurb: Wishing a very happy 56th birthday to Take That frontman Gary Barlow, born on January 20, 1971.

angles.name: Take That's Main Man
angles.copy: Happy 56th birthday to Gary Barlow! From Take That to his solo career, he's given us so many unforgettable songs. What's your favourite?

events.title: Billy Ocean turns 77
events.blurb: Wishing a very happy 77th birthday to the Trinidadian-British soul and R&B singer Billy Ocean, born on January 21, 1950.

angles.name: Soul Legend's Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 77th birthday to the incredible Billy Ocean! His smooth vocals and infectious hits still get us dancing. What's your favourite?

events.title: First Rock and Roll Hall Of Fame induction (1989)
events.blurb: On this day in 1989, the Rock and Roll Hall Of Fame held its first-ever induction ceremony, honouring legends like Elvis Presley and The Beatles.

angles.name: Hall of Fame History
angles.copy: Thirty-eight years ago today, rock history was made with the first Rock and Roll Hall Of Fame induction ceremony. Who was in that inaugural class that blew you away?
